Resolves #19727

An in-flight request rejected when its worker port retires now carries `NEO_DEAD_PORT` and the target window ID, alongside the existing `PortDisconnectedError` name and message. The shared departure predicate can recognize the recorded target departure, so cleanup settles through the existing contract. Pending-map deletion and exact generation fencing are unchanged.

Evidence: L2 achieved (real worker methods and actual emitted rejection through the cleanup consumer); L2 required and met. No acceptance residual for this leaf. The separate film and headed-position outcome remains #19569.

Change class: restoration (`fix`) — fills the missing in-flight branch of the existing typed terminal.

## AC Evidence
| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `worker/ReplyLoss.spec.mjs` dispatches the request, retires the target port, and checks the actual name/message/code/window ID and deleted pending entry. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the channel-pair arm uses the actual emitted rejection; non-window-port controls retain rejection without departure evidence. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `worker/WindowDeparture.spec.mjs` takes the actual rejection through `isDeparture` and the unhandled boundary, with ordinary and foreign-worker failure controls. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: successor pending/reply controls in `ReplyLoss` and actual in-flight rejection in `draggable/DragZone.spec.mjs` require one proxy removal and no unexpected console/unhandled output. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The existing predicate and name-based handlers retain their contracts. No additional consumer catch or state owner was introduced.

## Test Evidence
A zero-file-change probe on the original `f502257a3a` source dispatched a real window request, then retired its port: the departure was recorded and the pending entry deleted, but the emitted error had no code/window identity and `isDeparture` returned false. A post-departure request already classified correctly. The same missing branch reproduced for an in-flight channel request; foreign, non-window and successor controls stayed distinct. The committed tests now retain those producer/consumer falsifiers.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted in Engine; the commit guards and hosted reusable PR baseline are the available gates. Source-size and syntax checks passed locally.

## Post-Merge Validation
Reconsume the repair in #19569's full film and native-position evidence. That consumer outcome has its own remaining choreography and evidence gates; this PR does not close it or retire a hosted quarantine.
